workarounds.symptom: codemode: a nested tool result with isError: true shows as success in an eval cell
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(codemode): a nested tool result with isError: true counts as a failure. Target files: packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts, packages/coding-agent/src/core/execute-tool-on-host.ts, packages/senpi-codemode/src/tool/tool-result-marshal.ts. A tool that fails the documented way, by returning `isError: true` instead of throwing (`packages/agent/src/types.ts`, `AgentToolResult.isError`), counted as a **successful** nested call inside an eval cell. The row showed `✓`, the failure text appeared as the result preview... (Ref: https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/6906)

workarounds.symptom: Manual model switch during a retry/fallback loop is cancelled or charged to the picked model instead of continuing on it
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(coding-agent): a manual model change takes over a live retry loop. Target files: packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts, packages/coding-agent/test/suite/regressions/6893-manual-switch-during-retry.test.ts, packages/coding-agent/test/suite/retry-fallback-revert.test.ts. A manual model change (`set_model` over RPC, `setModel`, model cycle) made while a turn sits in the automatic retry / fallback loop now takes over that loop: (Ref: https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/6894)

workarounds.symptom: Release: no auditable way to waive the hosted CI wait for a pinned commit with an existing CI-basis receipt
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(ci): refuse a blank CI-basis receipt and stop on a red hosted run it would waive. Target files: .github/workflows/publish-npm.yml, scripts/publish-ci-basis-receipt.test.mjs, scripts/release-ci-evidence.mjs.
